name: Steak, Roasted Carrots & Red Onion with Chimichurri Sauce

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and cut onions into 8 wedges. Transfer to a sheet pan. Wash and peel carrots. Slice into thirds crosswise, then halve or quarter lengthwise. Add to sheet.
Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange in a single layer and place in the oven. Roast, tossing once halfway through, until carrots are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Season steak with salt and pepper. Add to skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1.02 kg ribeye steak
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together parsley, garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place steak, carrots, and onion on a plate and drizzle with chimichurri sauce. Enjoy!
